To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
mobile learning has a great potential in formal learning environments, but its integration is not always successful, and it is not always beneficial.
mobile learning has a significant potential to improve the teaching and learning experience, however, it can also bring negative effects to the classroom environment.

mobile learning is a promising approach that has the potential to enhance students’ learning, but it also has a dark side that needs to be taken into account by the teachers and the educational institutions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how technology can be integrated into the classroom environment without jeopardizing the quality of the learning process.
the use of technology and the way it is being used in the classroom.
the use of digital devices in formal teaching and learning contexts and how this can impact the quality and richness of the classroom dynamics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
technology is not a panacea and that its implementation in the classroom must be done with caution and with a critical eye.
technology is not the answer to the problems that education is facing, but it is a tool to be used wisely in the classroom.
technology should be used in the classroom as an educational tool to facilitate learning, but it should not be allowed as a distraction to the teacher and to the learning process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
technology is a double-edged sword that can be used for good purposes but also for the worst ones.

the integration of technology in the learning environment has to be done carefully in order to preserve the quality of the learning process and to avoid the addictive behavior that technology can induce.
the classroom is a place where students should be engaged in a meaningful and collaborative process that is not only technology-based, but also technology-supported.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the teacher should be the main decision-maker when it comes to the use of digital technologies in the classroom, and that the teacher should always have a plan B for the classroom, in case the students are not able to pay attention to the lesson because of the use of mobile phones.
the use of mobile devices in the classroom is still a matter of discussion and we should be aware of the possible negative impacts that this use might have on the learning process.
technology is an important tool for the learning process, but the use of technology must be planned and guided by the teacher to guarantee the quality and richness of the learning experience.
